notes.title: Keyboard Support is Coming
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First, I want to thank you all for playing Dead Noir the Heart I hope you're enjoying it. I have already started working on an update that adds Keyboard support for all menus in the game and it should be out fairly soon.
